body:
Update: a smaller packing replaces the one in this request.

The side is now 9.994038766610 (rounded up at 12 places). The exact rational side is 99940387666098521323/10000000000000000000. This is 9e-8 below the side in the request above.

The certificate is in the folder `n90` of https://github.com/JoostdeWinter/square-packing at commit fa53fb0d734fbf438bcfb73c1434a15894bb2bc5 (`n90/n90_exact.json` and `n90/n90_witness.yaml`). Please pin this commit and disregard the earlier one.

The same checks pass on the new files: `verify_exact.py` and `check_area.py` each report 90 squares and 199 close pairs, and `check_rational_witness_independent.py` of jlevy/squares reports "VERIFIED: 90 squares, 4005 pairs". The witness file validates against the schema with 0 errors.

The arrangement, lineage, credit and AI assistance are as stated above. The full updated text is in `n90/REGISTRATION.md`.
title: Lowered upper bound for n = 90 (side 9.994038766610): registration request
